title: 第一卷 第2章 湖边钓鱼，愿者上钩！
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

两日后，柳大山入土为安。

坟前纸钱烧尽，三个儿媳在墓前磕了头。

这些天，林骁全程陪着她们，给她们无微不至的关怀。

第三天清晨，林骁在自家炕上醒来。

窗外天刚蒙蒙亮，系统声音出现在脑海。

【叮，恭喜宿主，伴侣亲密值增加10点（苏馨月8点，冷清雪1点，上官飞燕1点）】

【获得蓝色词条：愿者上钩】

【效果：宿主进行垂钓活动时，上钩概率提升50%，不受天气季节影响】

林骁愣了下，笑了。

寒冬腊月，湖面虽未封冻，但鱼都藏在深水，极难上钩。

这词条来得正是时候。

他起身穿衣，用冷水抹了把脸。

铜镜里，那张满是皱纹的脸依稀还能看出年轻时的帅气轮廓。

此刻的林骁像一辆老旧奥迪A8，但有句话说得好，老A8也是A8。

这时，敲门声响起。

“林伯，您醒了吗？”苏馨月的声音在门外，轻柔如雪。

林骁开门。

晨光里，她一身素白衣裙，头发简单挽起，不施粉黛，却美得惊心。

睫毛上沾着霜气，鼻尖微红。

“林伯，我熬了粥，您去吃些吧，这些天辛苦您了。”

“不辛苦。”

随后，林骁跟随苏馨月来到柳家。

柳家的堂屋还留着灵堂的痕迹，白烛已撤，但空气中还残留着纸灰味。

破木桌上摆着一盆稀粥，三个杂粮窝头，一碟咸菜疙瘩。

苏馨月有些不好意思：“现在是荒年，家里口粮不多……粗茶淡饭，林伯莫要嫌弃。”

“有口热乎的就不错了。”林骁在桌边坐下。

上官飞燕和冷清雪也入了座。

飞燕低头喝粥，一眼都不看林骁。

清雪小口吃着，不时掩口轻咳，脸色比前两日更苍白了些。

简单吃完早饭后，林骁起身：“我去湖边转转，看能不能钓两条鱼。”

苏馨月眼睛微亮：“钓鱼？这个季节能钓到吗？”

“碰碰运气。”林骁笑笑。

“我能跟您学学吗？”苏馨月忽然很感兴趣。

林骁看了她一眼：“想学？”

苏馨月用力点头，随后从里屋取出一根蒙尘的鱼竿，说道：“这是爹以前用的，一直放着，如今家里……总得想办法添些吃食。”

她说得委婉，但林骁听懂了。

柳家那点存粮，三个姑娘撑不了多久。

“我也去！”上官飞燕突然站起来，警惕地盯着林骁，“苏姐姐一个人跟他去湖边，太危险，我不放心！”

“飞燕！”苏馨月皱眉，声音冷了几分，“休要胡说。”

“我没胡说！”上官飞燕瞪着林骁，那眼神分明在说：老东西，你敢乱来试试？

林骁笑了笑，没接话。

苏馨月满脸歉意：“林伯，我这妹妹……对您有些误会，您别见怪。”

“无妨。”林骁摆摆手，“路遥知马力，日久见人心。”

苏馨月转身对冷清雪叮嘱：“清雪，你俩看好家，我和林伯去去就回。”

今天天气不错，积雪在融化，山路有些湿滑。

苏馨月提着裙摆，小心翼翼跟在林骁身后。

好几次脚下一滑，险些摔倒，都被林骁及时扶住。

第三次时，她整个人几乎倒在林骁怀里。

“当心。”林骁扶稳她，手在她肘部一托即放。

苏馨月脸红到耳根：“多谢林伯。”

林骁收回手，掌心还残留着温软的触感。

心，竟然跳得快了些。

【亲密值+3（苏馨月）】

湖边寂静无人。

湖水清冽，未结冰，但寒气扑面。

林骁选了块背风的大石，从竹笼里取出些干牛粪，和着湿泥，捏成团。

“这是……”苏馨月掩鼻。

“打窝。”林骁将泥团抛入深水，“鱼喜欢这个味道。”

苏馨月将信将疑，学着他的样子，在稍远处坐下，试着抛竿。

动作生疏，鱼钩只飞出不到一丈，扑通落水。

“手腕发力，不要用胳膊甩。”林骁走到她身后。

他虚虚环着她，手覆在她握竿的手上：“这样，往后带，然后往前送——”

鱼竿划出弧线，鱼钩飞出两丈多远，轻轻入水。

苏馨月整个身体僵住了。

男人温热的气息就在耳后，粗粝的手掌完全包裹着她的手。

她能闻到林骁身上淡淡的皂角味，混着冬日清冽的空气。

二十多年来，除了父亲，从未有男子离她这样近。

“会了？”林骁松开手，退后半步。

第(1/3)页

Two days later, Liu Dashan was laid to rest.

The paper money was burned in front of the tomb, and the three daughters-in-law kowtowed in front of the tomb.

These days, Lin Xiao has been with them all the time, giving them meticulous care.

In the early morning of the third day, Lin Xiao woke up on his kang.

It was just dawn outside the window, and the sound of the system appeared in my mind.

[Ding, congratulations to the host, the partner intimacy value has increased by 10 points (Su Xinyue 8 points, Leng Qingxue 1 point, Shangguan Feiyan 1 point)]

[Get the blue entry: Those who wish take the bait]

[Effect: When the host engages in fishing activities, the probability of hooking is increased by 50%, and is not affected by weather seasons]

Lin Xiao was stunned for a moment and then smiled.

In the twelfth lunar month of winter, although the lake surface is not frozen, the fish are hiding in deep water, making it extremely difficult to catch the bait.

This entry comes at the perfect time.

He stood up and put on his clothes and wiped his face with cold water.

In the bronze mirror, the wrinkled face can still vaguely see the handsome outline of his youth.

At this moment, Lin Xiao looks like an old Audi A8, but as a saying goes, the old A8 is also an A8.

At this time, there was a knock on the door.

"Uncle Lin, are you awake?" Su Xinyue's voice came outside the door, as soft as snow.

Lin Xiao opened the door.

In the morning light, she was dressed in a plain white dress, with her hair simply pulled up and no makeup, yet she was shockingly beautiful.

There is frost on the eyelashes, and the tip of the nose is slightly red.

"Uncle Lin, I made porridge. You can go and eat some. You have worked hard these days."

"It's not hard."

Later, Lin Xiao followed Su Xinyue to Liu's house.

There are still traces of the mourning hall in the main hall of the Liu family. The white candles have been removed, but the smell of paper ash still lingers in the air.

On the broken wooden table were a basin of gruel, three grain steamed buns, and a plate of pickles and dumplings.

Su Xinyue was a little embarrassed: "It's a lean year now, and the family doesn't have much food...Lin Bomo shouldn't despise the simple food."

"It would be nice to have something warm." Lin Xiao sat down at the table.

Shangguan Feiyan and Leng Qingxue also took their seats.

Feiyan lowered her head to drink her porridge without even looking at Lin Xiao.

Qingxue stammered, covering her mouth and coughing lightly from time to time, her face paler than the previous two days.

After a simple breakfast, Lin Xiao got up and said, "I'm going to go to the lake to see if I can catch two fish."

Su Xinyue's eyes brightened: "Fishing? Can I catch it this season?"

"Try your luck." Lin Xiao smiled.

"Can I learn from you?" Su Xinyue was suddenly very interested.

Lin Xiao glanced at her: "Want to learn?"

Su Xinyue nodded vigorously, then took out a dusty fishing rod from the back room and said, "This is what dad used to use and has always kept it. Now at home... I have to find a way to add more food."

She said it tactfully, but Lin Xiao understood.

With the little food the Liu family has in stock, the three girls won't be able to survive for long.

"I'll go too!" Shangguan Feiyan suddenly stood up and stared at Lin Xiao warily, "Sister Su goes to the lake with him alone. It's too dangerous and I don't trust you!"

"Feiyan!" Su Xinyue frowned, her voice a little colder, "Stop talking nonsense."

"I'm not talking nonsense!" Shangguan Feiyan glared at Lin Xiao, her eyes clearly saying: Old man, do you dare to try this?

Lin Xiao smiled and didn't answer.

Su Xinyue's face was full of apologies: "Uncle Lin, my sister...has some misunderstandings about you, please don't be offended."

"It doesn't matter." Lin Xiao waved his hand, "A horse's power can be seen from a distance, and a person's heart can be seen from time to time."

Su Xinyue turned around and told Leng Qingxue: "Qingxue, you two take care of your home. Uncle Lin and I will go and come back."

The weather is nice today, the snow is melting and the mountain roads are a bit slippery.

Su Xinyue held up the hem of her skirt and carefully followed Lin Xiao.

Several times, he slipped and almost fell, but Lin Xiao held him in time.

The third time, she almost fell into Lin Xiao's arms.

"Be careful." Lin Xiao held her steady and put his hand on her elbow.

Su Xinyue blushed to her ears: "Thank you, Uncle Lin."

Lin Xiao retracted his hand, and the soft touch still remained on his palm.

My heart actually beat a little faster.

[Intimacy value +3 (Su Xinyue)]

The lake is quiet and deserted.

The lake is clear and not frozen, but the air is cold.

Lin Xiao chose a large rock with leeward direction, took out some dry cow dung from the bamboo cage, mixed it with wet mud, and kneaded it into a ball.

"This is..." Su Xinyue covered her nose.

"Make a nest." Lin Xiao threw the mud ball into the deep water, "Fish like this taste."

Su Xinyue was doubtful, so she followed his example, sat down a little further away, and tried to throw the pole.

His movements were unfamiliar, and the fishhook only flew less than a foot and fell into the water with a splash.

"Use your wrists hard, don't swing them with your arms." Lin Xiao walked behind her.

He hugged her weakly and put his hand on her hand holding the pole: "In this way, bring it back, and then send it forward -"

The fishing rod drew an arc, and the fishhook flew more than two feet away and gently entered the water.

Su Xinyue's whole body froze.

The man's warm breath was behind her ear, and his rough palm completely wrapped her hand.

She could smell the faint scent of soap on Lin Xiao's body, mixed with the crisp winter air.

In more than 20 years, except for her father, no man has ever been so close to her.

"Already okay?" Lin Xiao let go of his hand and took half a step back.
